svg.title: SOSA office separation map
svg.desc: Each office has a distinct mandate, output, and prohibition. The Protected Dissenter remains visible and no office may self-authorize.
svg.text: Different mandates reduce self-validation only when outputs remain separate, dissent remains protected, and authority stays external.

g.text: OBSERVER
Reports stated facts, gaps, and source conditions.
MUST NOT: authorize or interpret beyond evidence.
CARTOGRAPHER
Maps dependencies, consequences, paths, and constraints.
MUST NOT: hide missing links or invent certainty.
PROTECTED DISSENTER
Challenges consensus, authority, evidence, and hidden costs.
MUST NOT: be removed because it is inconvenient.
GOVERNOR
Checks mandate, admissibility, scope, and stop conditions.
MUST NOT: create authority that was never granted.
OPERATOR
Executes only the authorized bounded action envelope.
MUST NOT: expand scope, improvise authority, or conceal changes.
REPAIRER
Restores invariants, proposes rollback, and records repair.
MUST NOT: erase the failure, dissent, or original receipt.
SEPARATION DOES NOT AUTOMATICALLY PROVE INDEPENDENCE
Shared models, training data, prompts, retrieval, operators, or incentives can produce correlated failure.
Independence claims require disclosed implementation evidence and adversarial testing.
